title: Renewal redlines + daily to-dos (personal)
body:
Quick notes  — Maya's inbox / scratchpad (finance/legal)

2026-03-10 morning check
- priority: Contracts up for renewal in next 45 days (see summer vendor list)
- hold any payment where contract redline pending unless AP escalates

TODAY'S MICRO-TODOs
[ ] Confirm invoice #7842 (Acme Analytics) amount matches PO 5591 — $18,240.00. Check invoice date: 2026-02-25.
    - contact: tara@acme-analytica.com (cc: ap@redwood)
    - note: vendor says early-payment discount applied but not on invoice PDF
[ ] Send draft redline for Data Processing Addendum to legal (quick cover note below)
[ ] Update renewal tracker row for 'QueryStream' subscription (auto-renew flag questionable)
[ ] Scan my sent Slack for any 'approve invoice' requests — reply to Jordan before 3pm

CONTRACT/REDLINE DRAFT (quick) — intended as cover note to Legal
Subject: Quick DPA redline request — Acme Analytics (PO 5591)
Hi Legal —
Acme submitted invoice 7842. We agreed to the DPA language in the last call but they reverted to their template. Requesting a quick review of attached redline focusing on:
  - data retention: change 5 years -> 13 months
  - subprocessors: add obligation to notify + 14-day termination right if violation
  - liability cap carve-out for data breach (suggest: unlimited for breach of customer data)
Can you take a quick pass today? If risky, hold payment and I can escalate with vendor.
Thanks,
Maya

SHORT EMAIL TO VENDOR (if asked to proceed)
Hi Tara —
We received invoice 7842 and have sent a DPA redline to our legal team for review. Could you confirm you can accept the following items so we can avoid holding payment?
  1) 13-month retention on customer data
  2) Subprocessor notice + 14-day termination window
If no, please share a contact w/ authority to agree.

OUTSTANDING QUESTIONS / NOTES TO SELF
- QueryStream renewal: Sales says we have demo credits that might convert to 10% off renewal — verify with contracts PR-278.
- Check if Acme discount was documented on Slack thread (search: "Acme discount Feb")
- Are there any items in the PO that require a new CO? PO 5591 looks clean but pricing table mismatch (line 3) — reconcile with procurement spreadsheet.

RISK ASSESSMENT (1-min)
- Invoice 7842: medium risk if DPA not aligned; vendor is mission-critical for analytics pipelines.
- QueryStream auto-renew: low immediate risk, but could auto-charge on 2026-04-20. Put reminder on calendar 2026-03-30 to make final decision.

DELEGATIONS / WHO TO PING
- Jordan Kim (AP): hold payment until I confirm, but can release if legal clears before EOD
- Priya Desai (Procurement): recon PO line items and confirm discount terms
- Legal triage channel: @legal-triage (fast lane) — add DPA tag

MINI-LOG (timestamps)
2026-03-10 08:22 — downloaded invoice 7842, flagged mismatch
2026-03-10 09:10 — messaged Tara (vendor) asking for confirmation of discount line
2026-03-10 09:35 — uploaded redline draft to Confluence (link in linked_artifacts)

PLANNED NEXT STEPS (tomorrow)
- Morning: follow up with Jordan on hold status; attach legal's reply if any
- Midday: reconcile PO vs invoice and update tracker row (include evidence column)
- Afternoon: quick call with vendor if discount not documented

SHORTHAND: IF LEGAL SAYS ->
- quick approval = proceed to payment after 2 checks
- needs negotiation = draft escalation note & copy CS lead

STUFF TO DELETE/ARCHIVE AFTER RESOLVE
- local copies of signed DPA (move to shared_drives/company/misc/contract-archive)
- temp screenshots of invoice threads

UNRESOLVED / TODO FOR LATER WEEKS
- Map recurring vendors to renewal month buckets (spreadsheet)
- Build zap to flag invoices > $10k automatically into legal-review queue

Random scratch: remember to update my "personal finance/legal" vault with a note about how we handled the Acme case — helps with precedent for future auto-renew negotiations.

-- end of today scratchpad --
Notes are messy. That's intentional. Keep short, action-focused entries.
